speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and have a history of easy bruising; could you tell me exactly how long the bleeding has lasted and what it looks like? Additionally, have you noticed any other symptoms like nosebleeds, blood in your urine, or excessive bleeding during your menstrual periods?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A or B (Congenital Factor Deficiency).

Given the male gender, family history of affected male relatives (uncle), and symptoms of hemarthrosis (joint swelling) alongside mucocutaneous bleeding, I need to confirm the specific factor deficiency. REQUEST TEST: PTT (Partial Thromboplastin Time), PT (Prothrombin Time), and Factor VIII and IX activity levels.
